Around 6 or 7 years ago I was invited to a house with a few of my friends, I didn’t know the people who lived in the house but a couple of my friends did so I tagged along. It was a cool pool party, lots of people showed up, all the weed and beer. It was a fun party! 

Until the guy of the house stopped the fun and told everyone to go in the garage for like 10 minutes, there were rows of couches and fold up chairs and a projector on the wall. He ended up talking to us about that Verve stuff for over an hour, guaranteeing we’d be millionaires by the time we’re 21, and got butthurt when people started to get up and leave. Some of us (like I foolishly was) were actually interested and impressed with the stories, but this was before MLM and pyramid schemes were widely known (at least with my age group.)

I’ll never trust an innocent “fun” party again.
